name: com.artisangames.weaponsystem
description: Ammo- and fire-rate-driven weapons for Unity. A plain C# Weapon base class handles ammo, reloading and shot intervals against an injectable clock, with ready-made raycast, projectile and guided-projectile weapons on top. MonoBehaviour projectiles and a time provider are included, but the weapon logic itself has no scene dependency, so it is fully unit testable.
